## MongoDB Patterns

### 1. PurchaseRequest Model with Auto-Generated ID

```javascript
// backend/models/PurchaseRequest.js
const mongoose = require('mongoose');

const purchaseRequestSchema = new mongoose.Schema({
  requestId: {
    type: String,
    required: true,
    unique: true
  },

  // Product Info (snapshot at request time)
  productId: {
    type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
    ref: 'ShopItem',
    required: true
  },
  productName: { type: String, required: true },
  productSKU: String,
  requestedQuantity: { type: Number, required: true, min: 1 },
  currentStock: Number,
  lowStockThreshold: Number,

  // Request Info
  requestedBy: {
    type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
    ref: 'User',
    required: true
  },
  balagruhaId: {
    type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
    ref: 'Balagruha',
    required: true
  },
  reason: {
    type: String,
    required: true,
    maxlength: 200
  },
  justification: {
    type: String,
    maxlength: 500
  },

  // Status
  status: {
    type: String,
    enum: ['pending_approval', 'approved', 'rejected', 'completed', 'cancelled'],
    default: 'pending_approval'
  },

  // Approval (filled by Admin)
  reviewedBy: {
    type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
    ref: 'User'
  },
  reviewedAt: Date,
  reviewNotes: String,

  // Purchase (filled by Purchase Manager after approval)
  supplierName: String,
  invoiceNumber: String,
  purchaseDate: Date,
  actualCost: Number,
  receivedQuantity: Number,

  // Completion (filled after stock update)
  completedBy: {
    type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
    ref: 'User'
  },
  completedAt: Date,
  inventoryTransactionId: {
    type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
    ref: 'InventoryTransaction'
  }
}, {
  timestamps: true
});

// Generate requestId before saving (if not exists)
purchaseRequestSchema.pre('save', async function(next) {
  if (!this.requestId) {
    // Get the last request
    const lastRequest = await this.constructor
      .findOne()
      .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
      .select('requestId');

    if (lastRequest && lastRequest.requestId) {
      const lastNumber = parseInt(lastRequest.requestId.split('-')[1]);
      this.requestId = `PR-${String(lastNumber + 1).padStart(3, '0')}`;
    } else {
      this.requestId = 'PR-001';
    }
  }
  next();
});

module.exports = mongoose.model('PurchaseRequest', purchaseRequestSchema);
```

## Controller Patterns

### 1. Create Purchase Request with Balagruha Validation

```javascript
// backend/controllers/shop/admin/purchaseRequestController.js
const PurchaseRequest = require('../../../models/PurchaseRequest');
const ShopItem = require('../../../models/shopItem');

exports.createPurchaseRequest = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { productId, requestedQuantity, reason, justification } = req.body;
    const userId = req.user._id;

    // Validate input
    if (!productId || !requestedQuantity || !reason) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Product ID, quantity, and reason are required'
      });
    }

    // Get product
    const product = await ShopItem.findById(productId).populate('balagruhaId');
    if (!product) {
      return res.status(404).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Product not found'
      });
    }

    // Backend validation: Check balagruha access (Purchase Manager only)
    if (req.user.role === 'purchase-manager') {
      if (product.balagruhaId && !req.user.balagruhaIds.includes(product.balagruhaId._id.toString())) {
        return res.status(403).json({
          success: false,
          message: 'You do not have access to this balagruha'
        });
      }
    }

    // Create purchase request (requestId auto-generated by pre-save hook)
    const purchaseRequest = new PurchaseRequest({
      productId: product._id,
      productName: product.name,
      productSKU: product.sku,
      requestedQuantity,
      currentStock: product.stock,
      lowStockThreshold: product.lowStockThreshold,
      requestedBy: userId,
      balagruhaId: product.balagruhaId._id,
      reason,
      justification,
      status: 'pending_approval'
    });

    await purchaseRequest.save();

    // Populate references
    await purchaseRequest.populate('requestedBy', 'name email');
    await purchaseRequest.populate('balagruhaId', 'name');
    await purchaseRequest.populate('productId', 'name sku');

    return res.status(201).json({
      success: true,
      message: 'Purchase request created successfully',
      data: purchaseRequest
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error creating purchase request:', error);
    return res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      message: 'Server error creating purchase request'
    });
  }
};
```

### 2. Get Own Requests (Purchase Manager)

```javascript
exports.getMyPurchaseRequests = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const userId = req.user._id;

    // Get only user's own requests
    const requests = await PurchaseRequest.find({ requestedBy: userId })
      .populate('requestedBy', 'name email')
      .populate('reviewedBy', 'name email')
      .populate('completedBy', 'name email')
      .populate('balagruhaId', 'name')
      .populate('productId', 'name sku stock')
      .sort({ createdAt: -1 });

    return res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      data: requests
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching purchase requests:', error);
    return res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      message: 'Server error fetching purchase requests'
    });
  }
};
```

### 3. Approve Request with Self-Approval Prevention

```javascript
exports.approvePurchaseRequest = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { id } = req.params;
    const { reviewNotes } = req.body;
    const adminId = req.user._id;

    // Find request
    const request = await PurchaseRequest.findById(id).populate('requestedBy', '_id name');
    if (!request) {
      return res.status(404).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Purchase request not found'
      });
    }

    // Validate status
    if (request.status !== 'pending_approval') {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: `Cannot approve request with status: ${request.status}`
      });
    }

    // Prevent self-approval
    if (request.requestedBy._id.toString() === adminId.toString()) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Cannot approve your own request. Another admin must approve.'
      });
    }

    // Approve request
    request.status = 'approved';
    request.reviewedBy = adminId;
    request.reviewedAt = new Date();
    request.reviewNotes = reviewNotes;

    await request.save();

    // Populate references
    await request.populate('reviewedBy', 'name email');
    await request.populate('balagruhaId', 'name');
    await request.populate('productId', 'name sku');

    return res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      message: 'Purchase request approved successfully',
      data: request
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error approving purchase request:', error);
    return res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      message: 'Server error approving purchase request'
    });
  }
};
```

### 4. Complete Request with Atomic Transaction

```javascript
const mongoose = require('mongoose');
const InventoryTransaction = require('../../../models/inventoryTransaction');

exports.completePurchaseRequest = async (req, res) => {
  const session = await mongoose.startSession();
  session.startTransaction();

  try {
    const { id } = req.params;
    const { supplierName, invoiceNumber, purchaseDate, actualCost, receivedQuantity } = req.body;
    const userId = req.user._id;

    // Validate input
    if (!supplierName || !invoiceNumber || !purchaseDate || !actualCost || !receivedQuantity) {
      await session.abortTransaction();
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'All purchase details are required'
      });
    }

    // Find request
    const request = await PurchaseRequest.findById(id).populate('productId').session(session);
    if (!request) {
      await session.abortTransaction();
      return res.status(404).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Purchase request not found'
      });
    }

    // Validate status
    if (request.status !== 'approved') {
      await session.abortTransaction();
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: `Cannot complete request with status: ${request.status}`
      });
    }

    // Idempotency check
    if (request.inventoryTransactionId) {
      await session.abortTransaction();
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'This request has already been completed and stock updated'
      });
    }

    // Validate ownership (Purchase Manager can only complete own requests)
    if (req.user.role === 'purchase-manager') {
      if (request.requestedBy.toString() !== userId.toString()) {
        await session.abortTransaction();
        return res.status(403).json({
          success: false,
          message: 'You can only complete your own requests'
        });
      }
    }

    // Step 1: Update product stock
    const product = request.productId;
    const newStock = product.stock + receivedQuantity;
    product.stock = newStock;
    await product.save({ session });

    // Step 2: Create inventory transaction
    const transaction = new InventoryTransaction({
      itemType: 'shop',
      itemId: product._id,
      transactionType: 'purchase_request',
      quantity: receivedQuantity,
      previousStock: product.stock - receivedQuantity,
      newStock: newStock,
      reference: {
        type: 'purchase_request',
        id: request._id
      },
      performedBy: userId,
      notes: `Purchase request ${request.requestId} completed. Supplier: ${supplierName}, Invoice: ${invoiceNumber}`
    });
    await transaction.save({ session });

    // Step 3: Update purchase request
    request.status = 'completed';
    request.supplierName = supplierName;
    request.invoiceNumber = invoiceNumber;
    request.purchaseDate = new Date(purchaseDate);
    request.actualCost = actualCost;
    request.receivedQuantity = receivedQuantity;
    request.completedBy = userId;
    request.completedAt = new Date();
    request.inventoryTransactionId = transaction._id;
    await request.save({ session });

    // Commit transaction
    await session.commitTransaction();

    // Populate references
    await request.populate('completedBy', 'name email');
    await request.populate('reviewedBy', 'name email');
    await request.populate('balagruhaId', 'name');
    await request.populate('productId', 'name sku stock');

    return res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      message: 'Stock updated successfully',
      data: {
        request,
        transaction,
        updatedStock: newStock
      }
    });
  } catch (error) {
    await session.abortTransaction();
    console.error('Error completing purchase request:', error);
    return res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      message: 'Server error completing purchase request'
    });
  } finally {
    session.endSession();
  }
};
```

## Frontend Patterns

### 1. Frontend Filtering by Balagruha

```jsx
// frontend/src/components/purchaseManagement/views/ShopInventoryView.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { getPurchaseRequests } from '../../../api';
import { useAuth } from '../../../contexts/AuthContext';

const ShopInventoryView = () => {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [requests, setRequests] = useState([]);
  const [filteredRequests, setFilteredRequests] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchRequests();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Frontend filtering by user role and balagruhaIds
    const filtered = requests.filter(request => {
      if (user.role === 'purchase-manager') {
        // Purchase Manager sees only:
        // 1. Own requests (requestedBy matches user._id)
        // 2. From assigned balagruhas
        return user.balagruhaIds.includes(request.balagruhaId._id) &&
               request.requestedBy._id === user._id;
      }
      // Admin sees all
      return true;
    });
    setFilteredRequests(filtered);
  }, [requests, user]);

  const fetchRequests = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const data = await getPurchaseRequests();
      setRequests(data);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load requests:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to load purchase requests');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return <div>Loading...</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold">Shop Inventory Purchase Requests</h1>
        {user.role === 'purchase-manager' && (
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(true)}
            className="px-6 py-3 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700"
          >
            + New Request
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Filters */}
      <SharedFilters
        filters={filters}
        onFilterChange={setFilters}
        userBalagruhas={user.balagruhaIds}
      />

      {/* Requests Table */}
      <div className="grid gap-4 mt-6">
        {filteredRequests.map(request => (
          <PurchaseRequestCard
            key={request._id}
            request={request}
            userRole={user.role}
            onApprove={handleApprove}
            onReject={handleReject}
            onUpdateStock={handleUpdateStock}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ShopInventoryView;
```

### 2. Dropdown-Based UI

```jsx
// frontend/src/components/purchaseManagement/PurchaseManagement.jsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import MachineRepairsView from './views/MachineRepairsView';
import ShopInventoryView from './views/ShopInventoryView';

const PurchaseManagement = () => {
  const [selectedView, setSelectedView] = useState('machine-repairs');

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto p-6">
      <div className="mb-6">
        <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">
          Purchase Type
        </label>
        <select
          value={selectedView}
          onChange={(e) => setSelectedView(e.target.value)}
          className="px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500"
        >
          <option value="machine-repairs">Machine Repairs</option>
          <option value="shop-inventory">Shop Inventory</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      {selectedView === 'machine-repairs' && <MachineRepairsView />}
      {selectedView === 'shop-inventory' && <ShopInventoryView />}
    </div>
  );
};

export default PurchaseManagement;
```

### 3. Create Purchase Request Modal

```jsx
// frontend/src/components/purchaseManagement/modals/CreatePurchaseRequestModal.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { getShopItems, createPurchaseRequest } from '../../../api';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';

const CreatePurchaseRequestModal = ({ isOpen, onClose, onSuccess, userBalagruhas }) => {
  const [products, setProducts] = useState([]);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    productId: '',
    requestedQuantity: '',
    reason: '',
    justification: ''
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      fetchProducts();
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  const fetchProducts = async () => {
    try {
      const data = await getShopItems();
      // Filter to only products from user's assigned balagruhas
      const filtered = data.filter(product =>
        userBalagruhas.includes(product.balagruhaId._id)
      );
      setProducts(filtered);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load products:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to load products');
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      await createPurchaseRequest(formData);
      toast.success('Purchase request created successfully');
      onSuccess();
      onClose();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to create request:', error);
      toast.error(error.response?.data?.message || 'Failed to create request');
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center z-50">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-lg p-6 max-w-2xl w-full">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-4">Create Purchase Request</h2>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          {/* Product Selection */}
          <div className="mb-4">
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">
              Product *
            </label>
            <select
              value={formData.productId}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, productId: e.target.value })}
              required
              className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg"
            >
              <option value="">Select a product</option>
              {products.map(product => (
                <option key={product._id} value={product._id}>
                  {product.name} (SKU: {product.sku}, Stock: {product.stock})
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Quantity */}
          <div className="mb-4">
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">
              Requested Quantity *
            </label>
            <input
              type="number"
              min="1"
              value={formData.requestedQuantity}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, requestedQuantity: e.target.value })}
              required
              className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Reason */}
          <div className="mb-4">
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">
              Reason * (max 200 chars)
            </label>
            <textarea
              value={formData.reason}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, reason: e.target.value })}
              maxLength={200}
              required
              rows={2}
              className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Justification */}
          <div className="mb-4">
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">
              Justification (optional, max 500 chars)
            </label>
            <textarea
              value={formData.justification}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, justification: e.target.value })}
              maxLength={500}
              rows={3}
              className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Buttons */}
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-4">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-6 py-3 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="px-6 py-3 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700"
            >
              Create Request
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default CreatePurchaseRequestModal;
```

## Validation Patterns

### 1. Backend Validation Middleware

```javascript
// backend/middleware/purchaseRequestValidation.js
exports.validateCreateRequest = (req, res, next) => {
  const { productId, requestedQuantity, reason } = req.body;

  if (!productId) {
    return res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      message: 'Product ID is required'
    });
  }

  if (!requestedQuantity || requestedQuantity < 1) {
    return res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      message: 'Requested quantity must be at least 1'
    });
  }

  if (!reason || reason.trim().length === 0) {
    return res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      message: 'Reason is required'
    });
  }

  if (reason.length > 200) {
    return res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      message: 'Reason must be 200 characters or less'
    });
  }

  next();
};
```

## Error Handling

### 1. Consistent Error Response Format

```javascript
// Backend error handler
const handleError = (res, error, defaultMessage = 'Server error') => {
  console.error(error);

  // Mongoose validation error
  if (error.name === 'ValidationError') {
    return res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      message: 'Validation error',
      errors: Object.values(error.errors).map(err => err.message)
    });
  }

  // Mongoose duplicate key error
  if (error.code === 11000) {
    return res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      message: 'Duplicate entry',
      field: Object.keys(error.keyPattern)[0]
    });
  }

  // Default error
  return res.status(500).json({
    success: false,
    message: error.message || defaultMessage
  });
};
```

### 2. Frontend Error Handling

```jsx
// Frontend error handling with toast
const handleApiError = (error, defaultMessage = 'An error occurred') => {
  const message = error.response?.data?.message || defaultMessage;
  toast.error(message);
  console.error('API Error:', error);
};

// Usage
try {
  await createPurchaseRequest(formData);
  toast.success('Request created successfully');
} catch (error) {
  handleApiError(error, 'Failed to create purchase request');
}
```
